summary: Ask for a password reset link

email.description: The email address of the account, not case sensitive

429.description: Too many requests from this address

description:
Always answers 202 with no body, whether or not an account exists, mail is set up or a reset is allowed, so the answer shows nothing about the address. When the account exists, has a password, is enabled and a reset by mail is offered, a link that works once for 30 minutes is mailed to it; at most 3 mails per address per hour. 5 requests per address (an IPv6 /48) in 15 minutes for this route and its check and confirm routes together, every request counted; more answers 429.

Needs: nothing (public)
